[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant offered tips for organizing a junk drawer, including purging and decluttering, using dividers or compartments, categorizing and grouping items, storing small items in small containers, keeping frequently used items accessible, and maintaining the drawer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant discussed the pros and cons of storing batteries with their corresponding devices versus separately and suggested a balanced approach.
